parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, facility ban, border/document restriction or organised targeting is documented, and courts have affirmed accountability for assaults on trans tourists (2026) and convicted an officer for beating a trans woman (2024), showing functioning recourse. Counterweights: no nationwide ban on transphobic discrimination in goods/services, housing, education or health care, a failed broader hate-crime bill, hostile political rhetoric, continuing transphobic violence, and northern anti-trans sentiment. Detention discrimination/systemic gaps are documented for residents, but visitor custody placement is undocumented—an open question, not an established exposure. This fits reduced-risk with uneven remedies, below jurisdictions with demonstrated service-equality enforcement.
